tasks.short: Compile and analyze test information for efficiency or malfunctions.

steps.what: Diagnose equipment malfunctions while watching the process.
Compile import draft v1 in the laboratory information system ({OTHER}) from the instrument file.
Check import draft v1 and reject a result the instrument file does not state.
File the checked import draft v1 in the laboratory information system ({OTHER}).
Analyze the compiled test information to determine operating efficiency.

tasks.design: The laboratory information system ({OTHER}) compiles import draft v1 from the instrument file fields sample, analyte and result. She checks that draft against the file, and the system files the checked draft. She still diagnoses the malfunction at the equipment and still determines operating efficiency, and no model writes a result.
tasks.previous_blocker: The instrument file and the laboratory information system stayed apart, so she retyped sample, analyte and result.
tasks.enabler_now: That system can be configured to import those named fields from the instrument file. No new code is required for the copy of fields that are already present.
tasks.still_hard: A missing field, a malfunction at the equipment, and the efficiency judgement stay with her.
tasks.human_edge: She decides whether a result is in the instrument file and whether the process is running efficiently.
tasks.altitude: She spends the retyping time on the malfunction and the efficiency judgement. She still accepts or rejects the draft before it is filed.

reach.task: Export the instrument file with sample, analyte and result filled in.
reach.learn: Which of those three fields the file left empty.

evidence.claim: An Irish ISO 17025 water laboratory replaced paper and Excel-based processes with a laboratory information system that imports instrument results and checks specifications. The digest gives no hours for that case.
Draft GMP Annex 22 says generative AI and large language models should not be used in critical GMP applications.
Dutch works-council law treats an audit trail that names staff as personal data, and consent applies when a tool is used to check performance.

assumptions: This task is one instrument batch inside the organisation. It does not include conferring with scientists, the safety walk, or directing personnel. She does not send the compiled record outside the organisation.
The instrument produces the instrument file. Named fields are sample, analyte and result. If a field is empty she types it, and that batch keeps today's effort on the import and the filing.

The diagnosis step is 45 because the in-person means share is 44.5. The efficiency step is 27 because the document means share is 26.3 and the small mail share stays with her. Import 12, check 8 and filing 8 split the screen and workbook shares.

The filing step stores import draft v1 unchanged. A later edit voids the check. The check is her remaining time on the compile, counted on s3, and is not deducted again. Upkeep is updating the field map when the instrument export changes.
The filed record names the sample, the analyte and the result. It does not score the chemist, so consent for a performance check is not required.
This laboratory is not assumed to be a pharmaceutical GMP site. The draft annex is why no model writes a result anyway. Runtime of the laboratory information system is not her effort.
unknowns: Whether this laboratory's instrument file already holds sample, analyte and result.
Whether its laboratory information system already imports those three fields.
research_questions: Which instruments export sample, analyte and result without her typing?

already_counted.description: Checking import draft v1 against the instrument file.

incremental.description: Update the field map when the instrument export changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: When every batch already has sample, analyte and result in the instrument file, filing the checked draft removes the retyping. When a field is empty on every batch she types it and this task saves none. A week with empty fields on about half the batches sits near the high end.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer with scientists and develop nonstandard tests.

steps.what: Confer with scientists and engineers to conduct analyses of the research projects.
Interpret test results and develop the nonstandard tests.

tasks.design: She confers with the scientists and engineers in the room, then interprets the results and develops the nonstandard test herself. No tool is added, and nothing about the conference or the test is drafted or filed by a machine.
tasks.previous_blocker: The nonstandard test and the reading of the results depend on the scientists in the room.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new removes that conference. The work stays with her.
tasks.still_hard: Judging a result the method was not built for, and agreeing the next test with the scientists.
tasks.human_edge: She decides what the result means and which nonstandard test to develop.
tasks.altitude: Her week on this task does not change. She still confers and still develops the nonstandard test.

reach.task: Run the nonstandard test the conference named.
reach.learn: Which result the scientists asked her to interpret.

evidence.claim: Conferring with scientists and developing a nonstandard test stay with the chemist.

assumptions: The conference is a meeting in the room. She does not send the test method outside the organisation. There is no structured input and no tool, so there is no field map to keep and the upkeep allowance is zero.
The conference step is 57 because the in-person means share is 56.9. The write-up of the nonstandard test holds the document, screen, workbook and mail shares.
unknowns: Whether a scientist in the room is employed by this company.
research_questions: Which research projects this week need a nonstandard test rather than a method the laboratory already runs?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The conference and the nonstandard test stay with her on every project, so this task saves none.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate laboratory safety procedures and improve them.

steps.what: Evaluate laboratory safety procedures to ensure compliance with standards.
Make the improvements needed when a procedure fails compliance.

tasks.design: She evaluates the laboratory safety procedures in the room and writes the improvements herself when a procedure fails a standard. No tool is added, and nothing about the finding or the procedure change is drafted or filed by a machine.
tasks.previous_blocker: Seeing whether a procedure is safe depends on the laboratory and the standard.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new removes that walk. The work stays with her.
tasks.still_hard: A procedure can pass on paper and still fail in the room.
tasks.human_edge: She decides whether the procedure meets the standard and what improvement it needs.
tasks.altitude: Her week on this task does not change. She still evaluates the procedures and still writes the improvements.

reach.task: Walk the laboratory with her while she evaluates one safety procedure.
reach.learn: Which standard that procedure must meet.

evidence.claim: Evaluating laboratory safety procedures and writing the improvements stay with the chemist.
The EU AI Act does not list ordinary reports and analysis in Annex III. Point 2 covers AI used as a safety component of water, gas, heating or electricity supply.

assumptions: She walks the procedures herself. No tool is added, and this design adds no AI safety component, so the upkeep allowance is zero and consent for a new tool is not required.
The evaluation step is 59 because the in-person means share is 58.6. The improvement write-up holds the document, screen, workbook and mail shares.
unknowns: Which safety standard binds the procedure she is evaluating.
research_questions: Which safety standard applies to the procedure she evaluates this week?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The walk and the procedure improvement stay with her whenever a procedure is evaluated, so this task saves none.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct personnel in test procedures for materials.

steps.what: Direct and advise personnel in the test procedures.
Coordinate the procedures for analyzing components and physical properties of materials.

tasks.design: She directs and advises the personnel in the room, then coordinates the procedures for the components and physical properties herself. No tool is added, and nothing about the direction or the procedures is drafted or filed by a machine.
tasks.previous_blocker: The technicians need direction on this material from someone who knows the procedure.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new removes that direction. The work stays with her.
tasks.still_hard: People, the material, and a procedure that can go wrong in the room.
tasks.human_edge: She decides which procedure the personnel follow for this material.
tasks.altitude: Her week on this task does not change. She still directs the personnel and still coordinates the procedures.

reach.task: Follow the test procedure she set for this material.
reach.learn: Which component the procedure is analyzing.

evidence.claim: Directing personnel in test procedures stays with the chemist in the room.

assumptions: Directing personnel is a conversation in the room. She does not send the procedure outside the organisation. No tool is added, so the upkeep allowance is zero.
The direction step is 68 because the in-person means share is 67.9. Coordinating the procedures holds the document, screen, workbook and mail shares.
unknowns: Whether the personnel she directs are chemical technicians or another role.
research_questions: Which component or physical property is the procedure analyzing for this material?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Direction in the room and coordination of the procedures stay with her for every material, so this task saves none.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still confers with scientists, walks the safety procedures, and directs the technicians. On test information she stops retyping sample, analyte and result when the instrument file already holds them, and she still checks that draft before it is filed.
reach: The chemical technician exports the instrument file with sample, analyte and result filled in.
The chemical technician runs the nonstandard test the conference named.
skills_to_grow: Reading an instrument file to see which of sample, analyte and result is missing.
The safety standard a laboratory procedure must meet.
role.ambitious_version: She still diagnoses the malfunction at the equipment and still decides operating efficiency. The import only carries sample, analyte and result after she has checked them.
